{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun pads''' were installed on [[Stokhli/Legends|Stokhli]] [[Spray stick/Legends|spray sticks]]. Located at the opposite end of the weapon to the nozzle, the stun pad was designed to deliver a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] shock to any creature trapped in the [[Spraynet/Legends|spraynet]] that remained conscious after being ensnared.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
